hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָ/עִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖/י רֹאֶ֑ה וְ/הַ/מַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a
hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
tokens.kjv: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

tokens.bdb: a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population
tokens.kjv: assembly, dwell in, dwelling(-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
tokens.enLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanation: tov — bom, correto, agradável, útil, virtuoso
tokens.explanationEn: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun

tokens.kjv: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
tokens.kjv: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, [phrase] displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), [phrase] exceedingly, [idiom] great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), [phrase] mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, [phrase] not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.
